chunks: Sejumlah sahabat kami, dari Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Khalid, dari ayahnya, dari Giyas, dari Abu Abdillah (alamah), yang berkata:
Sesungguhnya, Amirul Mukminin (semoga Allah memberinya kesejahteraan) tidak menyukai hewan-hewan diberi minum anggur.
ai.seo_question: Apakah Imam Ali tidak suka memberi anggur kepada hewan?
ai.summary: Hadith from al-Kafi records that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) disliked giving wine to animals, establishing an ethical preference for the consumption of intoxicants by livestock. This reflects the broader Shia jurisprudential principle of extending the moral and spiritual effects of khamr (intoxicants) beyond human consumption to animals, emphasizing their well-being and dignity. The narration highlights the practical application of the Commander of the Faithful's asceticism and attention to detail in daily life.
